utility_intro: **General utility:** Free MetaZoo holiday product every year.
overview: On January 1st, 2022, MetaZoo Games hosted the New Year's Tabletop Simulator tournament, where 1/1 NFT prizes were awarded:
- 1st Place: Gold 1-of-1 MetaZoo Games Token NFT
- 2nd Place: Silver 1-of-1 MetaZoo Games Token NFT
MetaZoo first announced a spinning-coin token for third place, a 1/1 Bronze Snowman, in December 2021, before scrapping that design.
No secondary activity for this collection.
